cards.ex: I picked up some Spanish while living in Spain.
cards.exUz: Men Ispaniyada yashab, biroz ispan tilini o'rganib oldim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani o'z-o'zidan, harakat qilib o'rganib qolmoq.

cards.ex: I need to brush up on my French before my trip.
cards.exUz: Sayohatimdan oldin fransuz tilini takrorlashim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Eski bilimlarni yangilash, takrorlash va esga solmoq.

cards.ex: I'm trying to figure out how to solve this problem.
cards.exUz: Men bu muammoni qanday yechishni aniqlashga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tushunishga harakat qilib, yechim topmoq.

cards.ex: It's difficult at first, but you'll get the hang of it.
cards.exUz: Avvaliga qiyin, lekin qo'lini olib ketasiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilishni o'rganib, mohirlik bilan bajara boshlash.

cards.ex: I've got a big exam tomorrow, so I need to hit the books.
cards.exUz: Ertaga katta imtihonim bor, shuning uchun kitobga yopishishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p vaqtini o'qishga sarflash, yaxshilab o'qish.

cards.ex: We had to learn the poem by heart.
cards.exUz: Biz she'rni yoddan bilishimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani to'liq esda saqlab qolish, yoddan bilmoq.

cards.ex: There's a steep learning curve when you start this job.
cards.exUz: Bu ishni boshlaganingizda qiyin o'rganish davri bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va qiyin o'rganish jarayoni, ko'p narsani qisqa vaqtda o'rganish.

cards.ex: I always take notes during lectures.
cards.exUz: Men har doim ma'ruzalar vaqtida yozib boraman.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni yozib olish, darsda yoki nutqda muhim joylarni yozib borish.

cards.ex: She knows that program inside out.
cards.exUz: U bu dasturni juda yaxshi biladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani juda yaxshi bilmoq, har bir detalini bilmoq.

cards.ex: It took me a while to grasp the concept of relativity.
cards.exUz: Nisbiylik tushunchasini anglash uchun menga biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Tushunchani tushunish, fikrni to'liq anglab yetmoq.

cards.ex: I didn't understand all the details, but I got the gist.
cards.exUz: Men barcha detallarni tushunmadim, lekin asosiy mazmunini tushundim.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy ma'noni tushunish, asosiy fikrni anglab yetmoq.

cards.ex: The best advertising is word of mouth.
cards.exUz: Eng yaxshi reklama - og'zaki ma'lumot.
cards.uzDef: Odamlardan odamlarga og'zaki ravishda tarqaladigan ma'lumot.

cards.ex: Don't be afraid to speak your mind.
cards.exUz: O'z fikringizni aytishdan qo'rqmang.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikringizni, his-tuyg'ularingizni erkin ifoda eting.

cards.ex: I was lost for words when I heard the news.
cards.exUz: Yangilikni eshitganimda gap topolmay qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Hayratdan yoki shokka tushib, gapirishga so'z topa olmaslik.

cards.ex: His name is on the tip of my tongue.
cards.exUz: Uning ismi tilim uchida turibdi.
cards.term: on the tip of my tongue
cards.uzDef: Biror so'zni eslashga harakat qilib, yodga tushira olmaslik.

cards.ex: In a nutshell, the project was a success.
cards.exUz: Qisqasi, loyiha muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa va aniq tarzda aytganda, asosiy mohiyatini aytib berish.

cards.ex: You have to read between the lines to understand what she really means.
cards.exUz: Uning aslida nimani nazarda tutayotganini tushunish uchun satrlar orasini o'qish kerak.
cards.uzDef: Aytilmagan ma'noni tushunishga harakat qilish, yashirin ma'noni anglash.

cards.ex: He struggled to get his point across in the meeting.
cards.exUz: U yig'ilishda o'z fikrini yetkazishga qiynaldi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini tushunarli va aniq tarzda boshqalarga yetkazish.

cards.ex: The trip was a great learning experience.
cards.exUz: Sayohat ajoyib o'rganish tajribasi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror vaziyatdan olingan saboq, yangi narsalarni o'rganish imkoniyati.

cards.ex: We need to think outside the box to solve this problem.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni hal qilish uchun standartdan tashqari fikrlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: An'anaviy fikrlash usullaridan tashqari, yangicha va ijodiy fikrlash.

cards.ex: It takes time to learn the ropes in a new job.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishda ishlarni o'rganish uchun vaqt kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror yangi ish yoki vaziyatni o'rganish, asosiy qoidalarni bilib olish.

cards.ex: I'm just testing the waters before I commit to anything.
cards.exUz: Men biror narsaga majburiyat olmasdan oldin sinab ko'rmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga kirishishdan oldin vaziyatni baholash, sinab ko'rish.

cards.ex: It's hard to keep up with all the new technology.
cards.exUz: Barcha yangi texnologiyalardan xabardor bo'lib turish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Yangi bilimlardan va o'zgarishlardan ortda qolmaslik, doimo xabardor bo'lib turish.

cards.ex: I've fallen behind in my studies.
cards.exUz: Men o'qishda ortda qoldim.
cards.uzDef: O'z vaqtida bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan ishlarni bajarishga ulgurmaslik.

cards.ex: I can get by with my basic Spanish.
cards.exUz: Men oddiy ispan tilim bilan o'tib keta olaman.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, zarur narsalarni qondirish, yashab qolish.

cards.ex: She's a quick study and picked up the language easily.
cards.exUz: U tez o'rganuvchi va tilni oson o'zlashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsalarni tez va oson o'rgana oladigan odam.

cards.ex: I built the website from scratch.
cards.exUz: Men veb-saytni noldan yaratdim.
cards.uzDef: Hech narsadan boshlamasdan, o'z qo'llaring bilan yaratish.

cards.ex: She has a good command of English.
cards.exUz: U ingliz tilini yaxshi biladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror til yoki ko'nikmani yaxshi darajada bilish.

cards.ex: I have a working knowledge of HTML.
cards.exUz: Menda HTML bo'yicha ishlay oladigan bilim bor.
cards.uzDef: Ishlash uchun yetarli bo'lgan bilim, amalda qo'llash mumkin bo'lgan bilim.

cards.ex: I've hit a wall with my writing.
cards.exUz: Men yozishda devorga urildim.
cards.uzDef: Biror vazifani bajarishda to'xtab qolish, hech qanday progress bo'lmaslik.
